name: teamclaude-status
description: Live usage monitoring for TeamClaude's linked Claude Max accounts: a status-bar quota chip and a click-through usage panel.

teamclaude.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the TeamClaude gateway (e.g. http://teamclaude-gateway:3456). Leave empty to auto-detect from teamclaude.json when present.

teamclaude.configPath.description: Path to teamclaude.json. Leave empty to use $TEAMCLAUDE_CONFIG or the standard ~/.config/teamclaude/teamclaude.json location.

teamclaude.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to poll the TeamClaude gateway while only the status bar is visible.

teamclaude.warningThreshold.description: Usage fraction (0-1) at which the status bar switches to a warning color.

teamclaude.criticalThreshold.description: Usage fraction (0-1) at which the status bar switches to a critical/error color. Defaults to the gateway's own switchThreshold when known.

teamclaude.maxStatusBarAccounts.description: Maximum number of account glyphs shown inline in the status bar before clipping to an ellipsis. The tooltip and popup always show every account.
